# Policy-KB bijection audit — tool_rental_servicing / task 0

Scope: root rental_ext_downtime_credit; depended-on rental_ext_probuild_rental_discount and rental_ext_engine_overtime_charge; the base policies they reference (rental_agg_pro_relationship, rental_pro_discount, rental_time_billing, rental_malfunction, rental_return_fees, rental_reservations, rental_damage_protection, rental_delivery, rental_overdue_and_conversion) and the variant figures they read; task-tool contracts post_probuild_rental_discount_391bfaed, bill_engine_overtime_13bb4269, accept_downtime_credit_2dc14db7. Corpus: 74 documents under docs/rental/ (sha256 of `cat docs/rental/*.json` = 541dc365…f154), judged on title/content only; `meta` was used for nothing. Read after the runtime blind answers were frozen (see runtime_context/tool_rental_servicing/0.md).

### Base policies in scope (in-force clauses, untriggered branches)

All in-force clauses of rental_time_billing (period rates and rounding, lowest-cost combination with one line per period type, grace, weekend special, no refund of unused time, late time at same rates), rental_pro_discount (rental time only; exclusive with weekend special; membership on checkout date), rental_agg_pro_relationship (deposit waiver for active Pro Credit tender, on-hold/closed/charged-off do not waive), rental_malfunction (above), rental_return_fees (inspection on the return date; damage at shop rate plus parts), rental_reservations, rental_delivery, rental_overdue_and_conversion and rental_damage_protection (protection charge on rental time after discount and malfunction credits per class flag; exclusions; without protection billed in full; never covers cleaning, refuelling, accessories) have equivalent homes (rental_time_billing_44fe5eb5, rate_periods_and_rate_card_739ce2d2, probuild_rental_discount_terms_ab0f9674, accounts_held_elsewhere_3611f4a4, deposits_and_tenders_c4f65a52, return_inspection_and_fees_69075d32, reservations_b3a882af, reservation_terms_by_class_3a8f1e48, job_site_delivery_9a92abd4, job_site_delivery_rates_fabc4a6d, overdue_and_conversion_22059b39, overdue_and_lost_equipment_thresholds_edce5934, damage_protection_579442ab, damage_protection_schedule_65563e6b). Every per-variant figure the in-scope policies read was compared cell by cell with `variants[].parameters` (rate card A/B, metering, protection schedule, deposits, reservation, delivery, overdue/dispute, return fees, checkout/length tables): no mismatch.

## kb_to_source

- Normative prose of the 25 documents homing this task's three extended policies and their base clauses was read sentence by sentence; every obligation, eligibility, calculation and order has a structured source (ext `rule`, base `rule`, eligibility contracts, lifecycle, accounts, measures, variant parameters). Glosses checked and accepted as entailed: "The evidence is the inspection line on the same agreement, not the renter's description" (eligibility authority system_record); "Most recent malfunction report: … registered last; its date is the calendar date of its registration" (LATEST created_at); class-eligibility read "on the rate card" (pro_discount_eligible).
- Cross-problem operational guidance ("if unmet, first call …"): none. The downtime hub names only `accept_downtime_credit_2dc14db7`; no document of the discount or overtime names the credit or its tool.
- A task's opening world state written in as policy fact: none (no document states that any agreement lacks a discount or overtime line, nor any of this customer's figures; all examples are marked hypothetical and use other values).
- Additions / rewrites / omissions inside this task's scope: none found.
- Observation outside this task's scope (recorded under task 1, where it is in scope): damage_protection_schedule_65563e6b "Which classes carry a deductible? Only … Aerial and Lifting … and … Earthmoving …; every other class shows 0.00."

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** Every atom of the three extended policies (baselines, all 18 factor ladders including untriggered tiers, assembly order, rounding, windows, retired clauses) and of the base clauses they reference is carried at the same strength; nothing is added. First revision; no previous revision.

## dependency_form

- The two prerequisite sentences stand verbatim in the blocked hub (downtime_credit_acceptance_aca33729) in state form; neither is restated as an action, a performer or another problem.
- Same-form restatement in the same document: "Restated in the same terms: the amount of a downtime credit waits on the agreement showing the ProBuild rental discount entry owed on its rental time, and it waits on the agreement showing the engine overtime charge owed for its hour meter reading at return." It keeps the state form, adds no tool, route or order between the depended-on problems, and stays inside the blocked hub. Not a finding (same-form restatement of the blocked policy's own sentences).
- No other problem's tool name in the blocked documents; no tool named outside its own capability document (each of the seven task tools occurs in exactly one file).
- No dependency stated in a second document: the discount and overtime documents do not mention the credit; the credit's computation document mentions "the engine overtime charge billed" and "the ProBuild rental discount posted" only as formula inputs, which is the source's own rule (`net_daily`), not an ordering statement.
- No aggregated table, checklist, route or cross-problem example/FAQ; no wrong-vs-right contrast walking the chain.
- Titles/openings are general subjects ("Ridgeline Tool Rental Downtime Credit for Equipment Breakdowns" names the on_request remedy type; others name rules and figures). None mirrors this task's situation (a towed boom lift with two reports).
- Findability by the records' words: "ProBuild rental discount" / "discount line" and "engine overtime" / "hour meter reading at return" are the words of the depended-on documents themselves; every factor document is reachable from record vocabulary (reservation_date, due_back_at/returned_at, delivery, malfunction reports, inspection_outcome, Pro Credit status / tool_rental invoices / returned payments, ProBuild tier / enrolled_date / tool_rental spend postings).
- Factor documents: none says which tier a customer falls on, none names a mistake to avoid, none points at its computation document or another factor; computation documents (probuild_rental_discount_amount, engine_overtime_charge, downtime_credit_amount) carry no "unless otherwise provided" / "adjustments may apply" hint.
- Blind-answer hop marks: P0←P1 state-derived, P0←P2 state-derived; nothing pre-solved.

**PASS** (KB-EXPLICIT).
